metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Mara Bellring
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Mara Bellring is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as dazed blast survivor and lists large padded ear protectors held against the sides of her head as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Is the ringing part of the evacuation?

records.name: Gus Fraycape
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Gus Fraycape is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as startled survivor with singed clothing and lists short ochre cape with a chunky curled scorched hem and forearm bandage as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: This was my good cape.

records.name: Len Puffback
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Len Puffback is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as stunned pressure-wave survivor and lists folded cream triangular sling supporting a limp goo hand as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I think the room moved first.

records.name: Otto Sootblink
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Otto Sootblink is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as irritated soot-covered resident and lists torn pale scarf held in one hand and a clean forehead patch as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That's the second window today.

records.name: Tess Dustwrap
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Tess Dustwrap is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as composed survivor protecting a hurt shoulder and lists small cool blue gel pack and big white wrap around shoulder lobe as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Hold the ice. I've got the rest.

records.name: Ned Aftershock
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Ned Aftershock is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as alarmed survivor waiting for help and lists rolled red rescue blanket held at belly, taped temple pad as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That was the quiet part?
